title: Ferry Remote Build Protocol v1
description:
Every standalone document exchanged or persisted by protocol v1.

The generated schema is a catalog expressed as `anyOf`; transport operations still determine
which concrete document is valid at each boundary.

anyOf.description: Persisted artifact provenance and integrity manifest.

iphoneos_sdk_version.description: iPhoneOS SDK version selected for the job.

rust_target.description: Rust target triple; physical builds require `aarch64-apple-ios`.

xcode_version.description: Xcode version selected for the job.

ArtifactDownloadRequest.description: Request to download one artifact to an explicit client path.

artifact_id.description: Stable artifact identifier from its manifest.

destination.description: Absolute client destination. Providers must not reinterpret it as a worker path.

ArtifactDownloadResult.description: Verified result of one provider artifact download.

local_path.description: Absolute client path containing verified bytes.

manifest.description: Verified manifest supplied by the worker.

ArtifactKind.description: Artifact kind returned by a remote build.

oneOf.description: Built `.app` directory, normally transported as an archive.
Xcode `.xcarchive` directory, normally transported as an archive.

ArtifactListRequest.description: Request to enumerate artifact manifests for one job.

ArtifactManifest.description: Immutable manifest binding source, worker, signing, and downloaded bytes.

source_repository.description: Source repository URL when Git source mode is used.

source_revision.description: Exact commit SHA when Git source mode is used.

source_snapshot.description: Whether explicit snapshot mode represented local changes.

ArtifactRecord.description: One downloadable artifact and its integrity metadata.

file_name.description: Portable filename proposed to the client.

size.description: Byte length reported by the producer.

mode.description: Signing mode used by the worker.

status.description: Most advanced independently proven signing state.

BuildProfile.description: Optimization profile requested from the remote worker.

CancellationAck.description: Provider acknowledgement of a cancellation request.

state.description: State observed after handling the request.

CancellationRequest.description: Request to cancel an active provider job.

CleanupConfirmation.description: Proof that provider-owned job material was removed or deliberately retained.

artifacts_retained.description: Whether provider retention policy deliberately kept artifact bytes.

completed_at_ms.description: Milliseconds since Unix epoch in UTC.

signing_material_removed.description: Whether decoded signing material and temporary keychains were removed.

workspace_removed.description: Whether the isolated source/build workspace was removed.

CleanupRequest.description: Request to remove provider-owned material for one job.

remove_artifacts.description: Whether retained artifact bytes should also be removed.

CleanupStatus.description: Cleanup result from the remote worker.

oneOf.description: Source, signing inputs, and temporary keychain were removed.
Cleanup completed with a safe warning.

DevelopmentTeam.description: Apple development team selected for signing.

DevelopmentTeamPlan.description: Development team expectation carried by a signing plan.

expected.description: Team that certificate, profile, application, and extensions must share.

DevicePlan.description: Registered physical iPhone selected for a development artifact.

required.description: Entitlements that must remain enabled and match the profile.

EntitlementSet.description: Validated entitlement dictionary for one signing target.

complete.description: Whether the provider has no further events for this job.

next_sequence.description: Sequence to use for the next page, when more data may arrive.

EventRequest.description: Request for an ordered page of job events.

after_sequence.description: Last sequence already consumed, or none for the first page.

limit.description: Maximum events to return; must be between 1 and 1000.

protocol_version.description: Highest protocol version supported by the client.

required_features.description: Features required before the client may submit a job.

capabilities.description: Capabilities active for this worker and provider configuration.

IosArtifactType.description: Physical-iPhone artifact type requested or advertised by a provider.

oneOf.description: Xcode archive retained for inspection or later export.

IosDeviceBuildRequest.description:
Declarative request for an official physical-iPhone build.

The request intentionally contains no executable, argument, environment, or secret-value
fields. Workers derive their fixed command plans from these validated inputs.

operation_id.description: Caller-owned operation identifier copied into every event.

requested_artifacts.description: Requested output kinds in deterministic order.

signing.description: Complete declarative signing plan containing opaque references, never secret bytes.

source.description: Required deterministic integrity and shape manifest for either source mode.

source_mode.description: How the provider obtains the source.

source_repository.description: Normalized HTTPS GitHub repository URL in Git mode.

source_revision.description: Exact lowercase 40-hex commit SHA in Git mode.

IosDeviceBuildResult.description: Provider result after a physical-iPhone build reaches a build-terminal state.

cleanup.description: Cleanup proof when cleanup already ran.

JobHandle.description: Provider response after accepting a build request.

created_at_ms.description: Milliseconds since Unix epoch in UTC.

JobState.description: Lifecycle state of one provider job.

oneOf.description: Provider accepted the request and allocated an identifier.
Worker is preparing or building the project.
Cancellation was accepted and cleanup is pending.
Provider is deleting remote job material.
Cleanup was attempted but did not complete.

ProtocolPath.description: Path string paired with explicit machine and root semantics.

semantics.description: How the path must be resolved.

ProtocolPathSemantics.description: Explicit interpretation of a path carried by the wire protocol.

oneOf.description: Path relative to the submitted `RustFerry` project root.
Path relative to the worker's isolated job root.
Absolute path on the client that submitted the request.
Provider-owned URI with no embedded credentials.

ProtocolVersion.description:
Semantic version of the remote-build wire protocol.

Peers with the same nonzero major version are compatible. A handshake selects the lower minor
version. A future pre-1 protocol must match both components exactly.

ProviderCapabilities.description: Deterministic capability inventory returned during handshake and doctor.

artifact_download.description: Whether verified artifact download is implemented.

artifact_listing.description: Whether artifact manifests can be enumerated after a job.

artifact_types.description: Artifact types the provider can return.

cache.description: Whether provider-side compilation caches are enabled.

cancellation.description: Whether the provider can cancel an active job.

cleanup.description: Whether explicit job cleanup is implemented.

ios_simulator_build.description: Whether iOS Simulator builds are implemented.

live_events.description: Whether callers can retrieve incremental events.

live_logs.description: Whether the provider exposes live log events.

max_source_bytes.description: Maximum accepted source bytes, or no provider-advertised limit.

personal_team.description: Whether Apple Personal Team provisioning is supported.

physical_device_access.description: Whether a worker may access an attached physical device.

retention_seconds.description: Artifact retention window in seconds, or provider-defined retention.

ProviderCheckStatus.description: Result status of one provider doctor check.

capabilities.description: Capabilities available under the checked configuration.

require_signing.description: Whether signing prerequisites must be checked.

ProviderFeature.description: One typed feature that a caller may require from a provider.

oneOf.description: Access to a physical iPhone attached to the worker.

profile.description: Opaque profile reference; never raw `.mobileprovision` bytes.

sequence.description: Strictly increasing event sequence within one job.

timestamp_ms.description: Milliseconds since Unix epoch in UTC.

oneOf.description: A concrete worker accepted the job.
Source manifest was converted into a bounded upload.
Worker verified the exact submitted source.

sha256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 digest of the source bundle or Git manifest.

tool.description: Executable name, never a shell command string.

oneOf.description: Structured compiler, signing, or validation diagnostic.
Signing phase opened without exposing secret values.
Client downloaded and hash-verified an artifact.

result.description: Build result when this was a build operation.

oneOf.description: A same-major future event ignored by this reader.

path.description: Optional path with explicit resolution semantics.

severity.description: Severity consumed by CLI and IDE adapters.

RemoteErrorInfo.description: Sanitized error embedded in an operation-finished event.

retryable.description: Whether retrying may succeed without changing the request.

SecretReference.description:
Serializable reference to secret material, never the material itself.

Construction and deserialization validate the identifier. The restricted
alphabet prevents paths, URLs, shell fragments, control characters, and
accidental inline `NAME=value` secret material from entering a protocol.

SecretReferenceKind.description: Storage namespace for an opaque secret reference.

oneOf.description: Name of a process environment variable populated outside the project.
Opaque entry in the operating-system credential store.
Name of a protected GitHub Actions secret.
Opaque secret handle understood only by the trusted remote worker.
Compile and inspect an iPhoneOS artifact without making it installable.
Persistent-Mac Personal Team flow configured interactively in Xcode.

allow_provisioning_updates.description: Explicit opt-in to official Xcode profile updates.

device.description: Required registered device for development and ad-hoc artifacts.

provisioning.description: Separate profile for each application and extension target.

signing.description: Opaque identity/password references for modes that import an identity.

team.description: Expected team for all code and profiles.

SigningReference.description: Serializable signing inputs containing references only, never secret bytes.

identity.description: Opaque reference to an encrypted identity bundle or configured identity.

password.description: Opaque reference to its password or passphrase, when required.

SigningStatus.description: Fine-grained signing progress; never collapse this into one success boolean.

oneOf.description: No certificate or provisioning validation has completed.
Certificate type, expiry, team, and private-key match validated.
Frameworks, libraries, and extensions signed inside-out.
Main application signed after nested code.
A validation or signing stage failed.

bundle_identifier.description: Bundle identifier encoded into its signature.

name.description: Stable target name used by per-target plans.

SigningTargetKind.description: Kind of code object in the required inside-out signing order.

oneOf.description: Widget, Live Activity, or other application extension.

SourceManifest.description: Canonical description of a source snapshot.

entries.description: Files sorted bytewise by portable path.

project_path.description: Portable workspace-relative project location, or dot for the workspace.

sha256.description: Digest of the canonical manifest fields other than this value.

SourceManifestEntry.description: One content-addressed regular file in a source manifest.

executable.description: Whether any executable bit was present on Unix; false on Windows.

path.description: Portable workspace-relative bundle path using slash separators.

sha256.description: Lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 digest of the file contents.

SourceMode.description: How a remote provider obtains source input.

oneOf.description: The worker checks out a pinned Git revision.
The client sends a verified content snapshot.

ValidationLevel.description: One validation level proven by a concrete build or inspection step.
